top_issues: Background mountain dome has a fallback checkerboard texture instead of a granite material.
Many boulders and the wooden bridge have flat, untextured brown shading with zero surface detail.
Planar UV projection on terrain causes extreme vertical texture stretching on the steep bridge abutments and stream banks.
Stream channel looks like a straight, hard-edged concrete drainage canal rather than organic sculpted Sierra granite slabs (ref4).
Hiker character is an untextured, naked, low-poly mannequin.
Pine needle ground texture is overscaled and repetitive, and the orange dirt trail looks spray-painted onto the surface.
code_suggestions: ue_main.py: Fix missing material assignment on the background granite dome (currently default checkerboard) and apply triplanar/world-aligned granite and wood materials to all boulders and the bridge.
ue_main.py: Use WorldAlignedTexture (triplanar projection) for the terrain material so steep stream banks and bridge abutments do not stretch vertically, and increase ground pine-needle tiling by 3x.
gen.py: Replace the sharp trapezoidal canal cross-section and boxy bridge abutments with smooth, multi-octave noise-warped granite slabs and varied bank slopes to match ref4.
gen.py / ue_main.py: Assign clothed 1980s hiker materials (flannel/shorts/pack) to the character mesh and fix conifer leaf card alpha/normals so foliage doesn't render as blocky brown planes.
